The Champion's Tunic goes unnamed in {{MK8D}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Descriptions BotW}} The Champion's Tunic is obtained from [[Impa]] in [[Kakariko Village]] after [[Link]] relives one of his [[Recovered Memories]]. The Champion's Tunic mirrors the signature blue cloth worn by the other [[Champion]]s, which are decorated with the symbol of the respective tool each Champion must wield against [[Calamity Ganon]]. As Link is the [[Hylian]] Champion, it is marked with the silhouette of the [[Master Sword]]. According to its description, it is only given to individuals who have won the respect of the [[Royal Family of Hyrule]]. When worn, the Champion's Tunic gives Link the [[See Enemy HP]] effect, allowing him to see an enemy's [[Life Gauge]] with a total numerical amount of their remaining health. The Champion's Tunic has the highest potential defense of any [[Armor]] present in the game, with a maximum defense of 32. It cannot be [[Dye]]d at the [[Kochi Dye Shop]], nor can it be sold. The Champion's Tunic is not part of any [[Armor Set]], though it consistently appears matched with the [[Hylian Trousers]] in promotional media, in each of Link's Recovered Memories and at the end of the game if Link has recovered all of his lost Memories. Similarly, the two aforementioned pieces of Armor are also paired with the [[Hylian Hood]] when Link is seen on horseback in promotional media. ====Enhancing==== {{Armor Levels|BotW|Champion's Tunic}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== A modified version of the Champion's Tunic appears briefly during {{TotK|-}}, worn by Link in [[Korok Forest]] during the [[Memory]] "[[The Master Sword's Power]]" and the subsequent expedition by Link and [[Princess Zelda|Zelda]] [[Beneath Hyrule Castle]]. The Champion's Tunic was later destroyed by [[Ganondorf]]'s attack on Link during the "[[The Awakening]]" Memory. Prior to these events, Zelda noted that the Champion's Tunic was becoming worn and decided to have it replaced with a new one. After reading ''[[Zelda's Diary]]'' inside [[Zelda's Secret Well]], Link learns that she has hidden the replacement, the [[Champion's Leathers]], in the [[Throne Room]] of [[Hyrule Castle]]. A reproduction of the Champion's Tunic as it appears in {{BotW|-}}, known as the [[Tunic of Memories]], can be purchased from [[Bargainer Statue]]s for 400 [[Poe]]s after all seven of the Bargainer Statues have been encountered. Neither the Champion's Leathers nor the Tunic of Memories have the [[See Enemy HP]] effect in {{TotK|-}}. ==Other Appearances== ===''amiibo''=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The Champion's Tunic appears as part of the {{BotW|-}} series Link (Archer) and Link (Rider) [[amiibo]], worn by [[Link]]. {{Noncanon|End}} ===''Animal Crossing: New Leaf''=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|Animal Crossing: New Leaf}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{MK8D|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The Champion's Tunic from {{BotW|-}} appears as part of an alternate costume for [[Link]] in the version 1.6.0 update for {{MK8D}}. {{Noncanon|End}} ===''The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim''=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The Champion's Tunic is available exclusively in the [[Nintendo Switch]] version of ''[[The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim]]''. It can be obtained from either scanning an [[amiibo]] related to {{TLoZ Series}}, or through finding it inside a [[Treasure Chest]] at the Throat of the World. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{HWDE|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Link can wear the Champion's Tunic as part of the {{HWDE}} exclusive Era of the Wilds Outfit. The [[Costume]] is unlocked after completing "[[The Armies of Ruin]]" [[Scenario]]. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{SSBU|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The Champion's Tunic appears as Link's standard costume in {{SSBU}}. The Champion's Outfit is a [[Mii Outfit]] for [[Mii Swordfighter]]s, paired with the [[Champion's Wig]] which is accessible to any [[Mii Fighter]]. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Descriptions AoC}} The Champion's Tunic appears in {{AoC}}.
